answer_1.quote: Unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) aims to generalise MT models trained on domains with typically large-scale bilingual parallel text to new domains without parallel data.
answer_1.outputs: The paper focuses on generating translated text in a new domain by adapting NMT models using unsupervised domain adaptation techniques, particularly when only monolingual data from one language is available in the new domain.

answer_2.quote: The experimental results show that our method achieves up to +1.5 BLEU improvement over other data selection baselines.
